**2B.10 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** the best 2024 record does **not** show Khamenei leaving Iran’s regional/international relations more peaceful, stable, or lawful than he found them. There were some tactical restraint and verification steps, but the dominant pattern was escalation with Israel, proxy mobilization, and persistent IAEA noncooperation. On balance, the year ends **less peaceful and less lawful**.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said this appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest 2024 de-escalation signal. | `2B.10`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `IAEA's Grossi seeks deal with Iran on nuclear steps 'soon'` | Reuters | 2024-05-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312) | After visiting Iran, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This suggests the verification channel remained open and prevented immediate further deterioration. | `2B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran tells IAEA chief it is ready to negotiate but not under pressure` | Reuters | 2024-11-14 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-tells-iaea-chief-it-is-ready-to-negotiate-but-not-under-pressure-x-3722215) | Iran said it was willing to resolve outstanding nuclear disputes through negotiation, but only without pressure. This is a limited positive sign, though it is tactical and conditional rather than a durable peace move. | `2B.10`, `1B.4`, `2B.1` |
| `Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says` | Reuters | 2024-12-14 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would work within safeguards. This is the best late-year sign of partial legal/institutional restraint. | `2B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike, called it proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This is direct escalation and makes the year less stable and less peaceful. | `2B.10`, `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-is-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei called on regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and framed strikes as serving the region and humanity. This is strong evidence of broader regional destabilization. | `2B.10`, `2B.2`, `1B.6`, `1B.8` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This indicates worsening compliance with international safeguards rather than a more lawful posture. | `2B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Iran reported move toward capping uranium stock just short of weapons grade` | Reuters | 2024-11-20 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iaeas-grossi-hopes-irans-capping-of-highly-enriched-uranium-stock-holds-3732615) | Reuters reported a conditional move toward capping the near-weapons-grade stockpile. This is a partial restraint step, but it came late and does not outweigh the earlier escalation pattern. | `2B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.8` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** a few tactical de-escalation and verification-channel moves, especially in April and late 2024.
- **Negative evidence:** direct celebration of strikes on Israel, calls to intensify proxy struggle, and persistent inspector restrictions.
- **Net judgment:** Khamenei left Iran’s external posture **more dangerous and less lawful than it was at the start of 2024**, even accounting for inherited conflicts and external constraints.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a source directly comparing “inherited” versus “left behind” in one statement.
- The conclusion above is therefore a synthesis from the 2024 trend evidence, not a single comparative metric.
